query.description: Text to search for; supports SQLite FTS5 wildcards and phrases.

accountUid.description: Deprecated: account uid to scope the search to; use `iriFilter` instead.

includeBody.description: Deprecated: when `true`, matches document bodies as well as titles; use `contentTypeFilter` instead.

contextSize.description: Characters of text around each match, split before and after; defaults to 48.

perspectiveAccountUid.description: Signed-in account uid; contacts are returned only when set, filtered to what that account can see.

pageSize.description: Maximum results per page; `0` or omitted returns all results.

pageToken.description: `nextPageToken` from a previous response, to fetch the next page.

iriFilter.description: `hm://` URL with optional GLOB wildcards scoping the search, such as `hm://<account>/cars/*`.

contentTypeFilter.description: Content types to match: `0` title, `1` document body, `2` comment, `3` contact.

entityKindFilter.description: Entity kinds to return: `1` space, `2` document, `3` comment, `4` contact.

input.description: The query string plus scope, type, and paging options.

description: Searches the network for documents, contacts, and comments matching a query string, with optional account, type, and paging filters.
